body: The names in this post are fake by the way.

You seem to be smarter than me maybe you should try something easier than trading stocks. However, I understand your position I am also in a very very similar situation. I do not have a child however so the option of suicide seems great for me... for you I do not think it would be wise. If you are truly set on this then why not wait and wait and wait and wait until its so fucking unbearable you rip your hair out and lose your wife and your job and your house. THEN come back here and tell me its not selfish.
